dialogues.speaker: Someone's Notes
dialogues.text: "...Due to the appearance of wild beasts and collapsing structures, we have put an urgent stop to excavations of the Chizhang Wall. We will summon everyone back to base camp, and reconvene there..."

dialogues.speaker: Someone's Notes
dialogues.text: "...The Sumpter Beast merchant team will arrive through the mountain tunnels. Our comrades should prepare to receive them..."

dialogues.speaker: Someone's Notes
dialogues.text: "...Also, get Wu the Seventh to roll the wine barrel in the cave away! The Boss doesn't want to see it!"
